scenes.name: 夜市巷子
scenes.space: a narrow night-market lane between two rows of wheeled food carts with canvas awnings, strings of bare bulbs hanging overhead along the lane, wet asphalt underfoot, a brick wall closing the far end of the lane
scenes.light: warm bulbs overhead, red and blue neon tubes reflected on the wet ground, deep shadows between the carts
scenes.palette: saturated red and blue neon accents against deep blue-grey shadows

props.name: 鐵盒
props.desc: a battered square pale-blue biscuit tin

pending: C01 小滿的髮型與服裝：原文沒寫，暫定黑色齊下巴短髮、磚紅色連帽衫
C02 雨衣男的長相：原文只寫穿雨衣，暫定四十多歲、方下巴、灰白鬍渣、深綠色雨衣
P01 鐵盒的外觀：原文只寫鐵盒，暫定淺藍色方形餅乾鐵盒
風格：依題材暫定手繪動畫電影風
工具：暫定圖像用 FLUX 3、影片用 Gemini Omni，提示詞用英文、台詞說普通話
log: EP01 結束時：小滿（C01-b，右袖從肩線裂開）跪在 S01 攤車旁的積水裡，雙手抱著鐵盒；鐵盒蓋上多了一道凹痕；雨衣男已離開；時間是雨夜
